stories.title: Flint councillor warns of HMO “unwelcome precedent” as officers recommend approval
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council officers have recommended approval for a plan to turn a three-bedroom house in Flint into a four-person house in multiple occupation, known as an HMO. stories.title: iking boots to stand-up: Outdoor boss from Flintshire swaps the great outdoors for the comedy stage
stories.summary: A outdoor centre boss from Flintshire is swapping hiking boots for a microphone after taking up stand-up comedy just two years ago. stories.title: Lettings and sales staff promoted at Cavendish’s Mold and Chester offices
stories.summary: A North Wales estate agent has promoted four members of staff. Annie O’Brien has been promoted to Lettings Development Manager at Cavendish’s Mold office. Colleague Sophie Lewis becomes Senior Lettings Negotiator and Valuer, also at Mold. Two further promotions have been made at the company’s Chester office.
